values.note: Camping at the three designated sites is free. Overnight camping at the shelter house needs a reservation and a flat $26 fee (call 620-449-2539, two weeks ahead encouraged).

values.note: The three designated primitive sites are first come, free; no reservations at Kansas state fishing lakes. Seven consecutive days, then five days off the area (K.A.R. 115-8-9(c)). The shelter house alone is reserved for overnight camping, by phone at 620-449-2539, $26 flat.

note: KDWP state fishing lake (92 acres, built 1927) north of Parsons: from US-59 take 40th Rd east 4 miles. Three designated primitive campsites; drinking water at the south restroom; the stone shelter house by the dam can be reserved for overnight group camping. Boat ramp, floating piers and walking trails, one along the spillway. --Claude
